meta.title: RFQ bid: Quantity below the minimum quantity
gaps: Configure a minimum quantity of 5 on the RFQ line or template
Verify the vendor's quantity-4 submission is refused specifically because it is below the configured minimum quantity
warnings: cannot test this case yet — no step can observe: Configure a minimum quantity of 5 on the RFQ line or template; Verify the vendor's quantity-4 submission is refused specifically because it is below the configured minimum quantity

steps.note: Use an RFQ stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add one line with requested quantity 5; the catalog cannot set the separate minimum-quantity rule.
Invite one QA vendor for the portal bid.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Move to the vendor-side session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the published RFQ's pricing form in the vendor portal.
Enter the below-minimum quote quantity from the case.
Attempt submission and observe whether the portal refuses it; without a configured minimum quantity this cannot prove the requested rule.
